It Takes a Village: Understanding Cost Share on Sponsored Projects

Hello MSU Faculty & Staff! In this module we will review key pre and post-award processes related to Cost Share, a.k.a. matching, at Morgan State University. Topics include proper cost share documentation practices, identifying sources of cost share, distinguishing between various types of cost share, and more. Please note that processes detailed in this module are specific to grant-funded activities. Some of the information may also be relevant to non-sponsored activity actions; however, policy and procedural differences may apply. We strive to continuously review these lessons to provide up-to-date guidance on Morgan's sponsored project processes. For questions related to the activities covered in this module that are not addressed in the module content, please contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator: Mr. Ryan Mobley, CRA, CFRA, CPRA Email: ryan.mobley@morgan.edu Phone: 443-885-4771 Thank you, ORA Training Team

Self-paced ORA eTraining module. Source: https://share.articulate.com/jQ-qp8p2axC-3ba_0hXae

This module has 7 lessons, each a separate knowledge base entry:
1. What is Cost Share?
2. Forms of Cost Share
3. Cost Share Classifications
4. Cost Share: Pre-Award
5. Cost Share: Post-Award
6. Cost Share Knowledge Review
7. Message from ORA
